policy: Two ineffective optimization iterations in one subsystem or three total without a meaningful comparable improvement require a fresh architecture review, including three alternatives and a decision.

iterations.reason: 32-request application improvement measured; sustained 100-RPS user-facing acceptance not achieved

iterations.change: Bypass unused D1 guest caches; R2 presentation projection
iterations.reason: 32-request application tail improved; sustained 50-RPS still showed severe application latency and dropped offered requests

alternatives: Incremental SQL/cache tuning with measured plan constraints
Single bounded primary-authoritative service call plus independent R2 presentation
Sharded strongly consistent rights-read service with withdrawal fence
Replace datastore/topology after independent service-capacity measurement
iterations.decision: Stop SQL-only tuning. First run noop versus rights-only versus full-catalog stage comparisons with paired D1 SQL and operation latency; prefer one authoritative round trip if rights safety and sustained RPS are proved.

iterations.change: Stop failed D1 shortlist/cache reads from amplifying into more expensive full-catalog/COUNT queries (draft PR #669)
iterations.reason: Mechanism is established by source and D1 overload records, but no controlled end-to-end 100-RPS candidate improvement has been measured; no production activation

iterations.change: Eliminate synonym D1 read when search tokens are absent (draft PR #669)
iterations.reason: Staging recorded 23 avoidable synonym spans averaging 100.96 ms wall; local integration validates zero read after change, but hosted p99/max and throughput effects not measured

alternatives: Further SQL micro-tuning with existing primary-D1 call count unchanged; reject without matched evidence
Remove entire nonauthorizing service operations and collapse rights/metadata to the minimum number of synchronous primary D1 calls while retaining exact current withdrawal checks
Repartition rights read-serving into independently scalable strongly consistent authoritative services or sharded storage with tested revocation fence
Replace the D1 rights-serving topology with a dedicated low-latency consistency-certified authority if rights-only capacity experiment demonstrates D1 service saturation
iterations.decision: The paired right-query traces still show p95 D1 operation wall 1731 ms against 2.68 ms average SQL execution. Stop incremental query/index work after these two inconclusive revisions. Next run no-DB, rights-only and full-catalog tests in the isolated environment; retry live stage only with correctly scoped access to synthetic D1. Do not use cached R2/KV display totals as positive legal authority or weaken any release gate.
